'''Blue Squadron''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Edor Crespin]], it was an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] training squadron, fighting alongside [[Wraith Squadron]] in the [[Hunt for Zsinj]]. Later, Blue Squadron provided cover for the evacuation efforts of the [[Battle of Calamari]].

==Description==
Blue Squadron was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] training [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]],<ref name="wraith" /> who flew fighters painted white with blue stripes marked with white triangles. The squadron's fighters were outfitted with advanced targeting and defensive systems and armed with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]], making up for the minimal shielding the fighters were equipped with.<ref name="mini">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=Blue Squadron A-wing|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/ship08a.jpg}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Battle of Calamari]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Blue Squadron was stationed at [[Pinnacle Base]] in the [[Cyax system/Legends|Cyax system]],<ref name="DE2" /> and had adopted the use of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] Blue Squadron underwent training at [[Folor Base]] alongside [[Wraith Squadron]]. Led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Edor Crespin]], the squadron fought with Wraith Squadron both offensively and defensively in the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against the [[Zsinj's Empire|Empire]] of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="wraith" />

===Battle of Folor===
{{Quote|Damned Blue Squadron!|[[Eurrsk Thri'ag]] at the [[Battle of Folor]]|<ref name="wraith" />}}
A Wraith Squadron navigational exercise was interrupted by the discovery of the Warlord Zsinj-aligned [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']]. Alerted of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] presence, [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]] General Crespin prepared to evacuate [[Folor]], directing [[Gold Squadron (New Republic)|Gold Squadron's]] A-wings to escort three [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] out of the system, and Blue and Wraith Squadrons to remain on station for a delaying action. While the Star Destroyer's commanding officer, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]], was fooled into bombarding the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] one-hundred-and-eighty degrees away from the base's actual position, two of the transports were able to escape, though the third, [[Borleias (transport)|''Borleias'']], suffered a malfunction, necessitating the starfighter squadrons to engage to buy it time. At the suggestion of [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], the two squadrons entered the lunar crevasse known as the "[[Trench (Folor)|Pig Trough]]," sending [[Blue Nine/Legends|Blue Nine]] [[Dorset Konnair]] and [[Blue Ten/Legends|Blue Ten]] [[Tetengo Noor]]&mdash;along with Wraiths [[Kell Tainer|Five]] and [[Hohass Ekwesh|Six]]&mdash;ahead as spotters. Arriving after the Wraiths despite their crafts' superior speed, the Blue Squadron pilots directed their visual sensors at the Imperials' expected position, with Noor as the first to detect ''Implacable''{{'s}} [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] complement. Transmitting the attacker's expected point of interception with the trench to Folor Base, the pilots conceived of a plan to remove the Star Destroyer from the engagement: Blue Nine and Ten flew wing-to-wing, oscillated their [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], and impersonated the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] through obsolete communications encryption. Taking the bait of the high-profile target, the Star Destroyer was lured off in pursuit.<ref name="wraith" />

As ''Implacable''{{'s}} six TIE squadrons crossed over the Pig Trough, the Blue Squadron rose out of the fissure, leaping over the X-wings of Wraith Squadron to engage the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] and their [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] escorts. In the confusion of the battle, a pilot with the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Blue Four/Legends|Blue Four]] mistakenly believed a squadron mate, "[[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]]," to have been killed in action, only to be reunited with the other pilot. As ''Borleias'' jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the New Republic squadrons broke off their attack and the "''Millennium Falcon''" group abandoned their deception. While the evacuation of Folor was a success, Blue Squadron lost five pilots, with most other sustaining serious damage to their starfighters.<ref name="wraith" />

===Battle of Ession===
As the culmination of Wraith Squadron's impersonation of the crew of the Zsinj-aligned [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], ''Implacable'' was lured into an [[Battle of Ession|ambush]] over [[Ession]]. Infiltrating the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] security aboard the derelict [[Super Transport VI]] [[Blood Nest|''Red Feathers'']], Blue Squadron&mdash;along with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Green Squadron (New Republic)|Green Squadrons]]&mdash;deployed as ''Red Feathers'' disintegrated in Ession's gravity. General Crespin's A-wings joined the Wraiths in combat, pursuing ''Implacable''{{'s}} TIEs as they fled Ession to defend the Star Destroyer. "Blue Nine" eliminated a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] on the tail of [[Wraith Five (callsign)|Wraith Five]] Kell Tainer before rejoining her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], "Blue Ten", and Crespin pursued Admiral Trigit and his bodyguards with [[Myn Donos]], [[Wraith Nine (callsign)|Wraith Nine]], offering the fleeing interceptor [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] the opportunity to surrender. His offer declined, the squadron leader closed with the TIEs and destroyed the admiral's wingmates, while Donos eliminated Trigit himself.<ref name="wraith" />

===Battle of Calamari===
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Blue Squadron, now an X-wing [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]],<ref name="CSWE" /> was sent from Pinnacle Base by Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]&mdash;along with Green Squadron&mdash;to cover the [[Battle of Calamari|evacuation]] of [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]], escorting the inhabitants of the planet ravaged by the [[Palpatine/Legends|reborn Emperor's]] [[World Devastator]]s to the [[Waterworld/Legends|water world]] of [[Da Soocha]].<ref name="DE2" />

===Battle of Almania===
In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], Blue Squadron was able to participate in the [[Battle of Almania]] while other X-wing squadrons were grounded due to being sabotaged with [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] armed with explosives.<ref name="NewRebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Blue Squadron's A-wing starfighters were first pictured when they were represented with a miniature featuring the art of [[Ralph McQuarrie]] in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' in [[June]] [[June 19|19]], [[2007]].<ref name="mini" />
